execution_message.text: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: KCK-03B2 individual model-sheet candidate, NOT animation or production. Input image 1 is the ONLY approved identity and rendering reference. Keep the exact Soft Handmade 2.5D illustrator treatment: dark warm brown hand outline, controlled fine paper/pencil grain, flat base colors with gentle volume, soft upper-left light. One isolated whole-body character only, genuine transparent background; no text, labels, panels, duplicates, floor, cast shadow, white matte or new props. Square canvas; entire ears, tail, feet and required prop inside a generous transparent margin on all sides. Keep approximately the same character mass/size and proportions across sheets; do not enlarge the head or shrink limbs. Eyes keep reference anatomy: large primary white glint in the UPPER LEFT of each visible open eye, small secondary glint LOWER RIGHT. Light direction is SCREEN upper left regardless of body rotation. Do not mirror the reference or transfer props between anatomical hands. This is one still PNG, no collage. Subject: approved orange-and-cream tabby Cat cat-02. Round broad head, pink inner ears and cheeks, brown iris AND visible white sclera, small brown nose, smile and tongue, three whiskers each side, clearly striped body and long curled striped tail, seated short-legged body with two cream feet. Raised pad-visible paw is the CAT'S LEFT paw (viewer right in front view); retain pink large central pad and three small toe pads. Other forepaw rests low. Keep original proportions and palette, no hair strands, clothing or accessories. Expression view: same near-front three-quarter full-body reference pose, camera, proportions and props. Change only the FACE to clearly happy: open cheerful smile with tongue for Cat, slightly open cheerful smile for Dinosaur; keep both EYES OPEN with original anatomy, correct upper-left primary/lower-right secondary glints. No closed eyes, jumps, extra teeth, props or pose change.
